data: Which two layers have an almost constant retraining accuracy for all weights?

The caption states that the figure shows layer sensitivity with the DistilBERT model. The lines represent different tasks: CoLA (green), MRPC (yellow), and RTE (brown). The x-axis represents model weights, and the y-axis represents retraining accuracy.

Looking at the graph, I need to identify which two layers have almost constant retraining accuracy across all weights. 

From the graph:
- The yellow line (MRPC) appears relatively flat and stable across the entire range of model weights.
- The brown line (RTE) also appears relatively flat and stable across the entire range of model weights.

These two lines show minimal variation in their retraining accuracy values compared to the green line (CoLA), which shows more fluctuations.

Therefore, the two layers with almost constant retraining accuracy for all weights are MRPC and RTE.
